overview: The **Quote Management** drop-in uses the [event bus](/sdk/reference/events) to emit and listen to events for communication between drop-ins and external integrations.

auth/permissions.description: Fired by Auth (`auth`) when Adobe Commerce permissions are updated.

checkout/updated.description: Fired by Checkout (`checkout`) when the component state is updated. Quote Management uses it to reload quote data when the checkout type is `quote`.

quote-management/file-upload-error.description: Emitted when `uploadFile()` fails to upload or finalize a file attachment.

quote-management/initialized.description: Emitted when the Quote Management initializer finishes loading store configuration.

quote-management/line-item-note-set.description: Emitted after `setLineItemNote()` updates a line item note for a negotiable quote.

quote-management/negotiable-quote-close-.description: Emitted when `closeNegotiableQuote()` fails to close one or more negotiable quotes.

quote-management/negotiable-quote-closed.description: Emitted after `closeNegotiableQuote()` closes one or more negotiable quotes.

quote-management/negotiable-quote-delete.description: Emitted when `deleteQuote()` fails to delete one or more negotiable quotes.
Emitted after `deleteQuote()` deletes one or more negotiable quotes.

quote-management/negotiable-quote-reques.description: Emitted after `requestNegotiableQuote()` creates a negotiable quote from a cart.

quote-management/permissions.description: Emitted when the permissions state for Quote Management changes (for example, after `auth/permissions` is processed or on logout).

quote-management/quantities-updated.description: Emitted after `updateQuantities()` updates item quantities in a negotiable quote.

quote-management/quote-data.description: Emitted when negotiable quote data is loaded or updated.

quote-management/quote-data/error.description: Emitted when Quote Management fails to load negotiable quote data during initialization.

quote-management/quote-data/initialized.description: Emitted the first time Quote Management successfully loads negotiable quote data during initialization.

quote-management/quote-duplicated.description: Emitted after `duplicateQuote()` creates a copy of a negotiable quote.

quote-management/quote-items-removed.description: Emitted after `removeNegotiableQuoteItems()` removes one or more items from a negotiable quote.

quote-management/quote-renamed.description: Emitted after `renameNegotiableQuote()` updates the name (and optional comment) of a negotiable quote.

quote-management/quote-sent-for-review.description: Emitted after `sendForReview()` submits a negotiable quote for merchant review.

quote-management/quote-template-data.description: Emitted when quote template data is loaded or updated.

quote-management/quote-template-data/err.description: Emitted when Quote Management fails to load quote template data during initialization.

quote-management/quote-template-deleted.description: Emitted after `deleteQuoteTemplate()` deletes a quote template.

quote-management/quote-template-generate.description: Emitted after `generateQuoteFromTemplate()` creates a new negotiable quote from a template.

quote-management/quote-templates-data.description: Emitted after `getQuoteTemplates()` loads the quote templates list.

quote-management/shipping-address-set.description: Emitted after `setShippingAddress()` updates the shipping address for a negotiable quote.
